**Finding submitted: `missing` (medium severity, confidence 0.86)**

**What I checked:**
- **§ 6 (Termination)** — only covers notice periods (15 days either way), final payment through the termination date, and assignment of Works in progress. No wind-down mechanic.
- **§ 4 (Ownership/Acceptance)** — establishes Company ownership of Works and post-termination modification rights, but never obliges RadialSpark to *deliver back* Clear Capital data.
- **§ 8 (Confidential Information, p0038–p0040)** — use and disclosure restrictions only; conspicuously lacks the usual return-or-destroy tail.
- **p0044** — a duplicated effects-of-termination paragraph misfiled under § 7, to the same limited effect as § 6(b).

**Conclusion:** no transition assistance, no data export obligation, and no deletion timing or certification anywhere in the Agreement. This fails even the fallback position (90 days assistance + export within 30 days), so an insert is warranted rather than a rationale note.

**Redline (validated `ok:true`)** — new § 6(c) inserted after p0033, tracking the preferred position and the `seed-transition` precedent:

> (c) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Contractor shall (i) at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Contractor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days... return to Company all Company data, Works and Confidential Information... in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all such data, Works and Confidential Information from its systems and certify such deletion to Company in writing.

Two drafting notes on the insert: I extended the return obligation to cover **Works and Confidential Information** alongside data, since this is a development engagement where our value sits in deliverables and source materials rather than a hosted data set, and the confidentiality clause has no return tail to rely on. I also placed the clause in § 6 rather than next to the stray p0044 paragraph, so the operative termination section is self-contained. Worth flagging separately that p0044 duplicates § 6(b)'s payment and Works-assignment language under § 7 — harmless here, but if § 6(c) is negotiated, confirm no conflicting wind-down text gets added at p0044.

Fallback if RadialSpark resists: 90 days of assistance, holding the 30-day export and certified deletion.
